front: The 8 AWS responsible AI dimensions
back: Fairness, explainability, privacy and security, safety, controllability, veracity and robustness, governance, transparency. Đề mô tả vấn đề, bạn gọi đúng tên dimension rồi chọn control.

front: Customers need to know why the AI declined them
back: Explainability. Người bị ảnh hưởng cần lý do cho từng quyết định.

front: Users did not know they were talking to AI
back: Transparency: disclose AI interaction, offer a human option. EU AI Act Article 50 cũng yêu cầu điều này.

front: Accuracy vs explainability for decisions about people
back: Pick the interpretable model if it meets the business threshold, and document the tradeoff. Accuracy cao hơn không bù được việc không giải thích được.

front: MOST effective time to integrate responsible AI
back: At use case definition, before data collection and build (responsible by design). Review sát go-live là bẫy.

front: Teams disagree on whether the model is good enough
back: Agree on release criteria: metrics and thresholds per harm and benefit. Có tiêu chí rồi mới evaluation.

front: Human-in-the-loop vs human-on-the-loop
back: HITL approves each output before it takes effect; HOTL monitors KRIs and samples and intervenes when needed. Đáp án tốt thường kết hợp theo tier.

front: Escalation criteria for an AI agent
back: High impact (denials, large amounts, exceptions), low confidence, irreversible actions. Case thường thì tự động và theo dõi.

front: EU AI Act human oversight for high-risk systems
back: Competent people who can disregard, override, reverse, or stop the system, aware of automation bias. Đây là Article 14.

front: FIRST step to govern AI across many business units
back: Form a cross-functional governance team with executive sponsorship and decision rights. AWS CAF for AI nêu đúng bước này.

front: Data science team approves its own models
back: Wrong: require independent second-line review (risk or compliance). Người build không tự duyệt.

ref.label: AWS blog: AI enterprise risk management

front: EU AI Act risk tiers
back: Unacceptable (prohibited), high-risk, limited (transparency), minimal. Tuyển dụng, tín dụng, giáo dục nằm ở high-risk theo Annex III.

front: EU AI Act high-risk deadlines after the Digital Omnibus
EU AI Act maximum fine for prohibited practices
back: Up to EUR 35 million or 7% of worldwide annual turnover. Phần lớn nghĩa vụ khác: EUR 15 million hoặc 3%.

front: GDPR Article 22
back: Right not to be subject to a solely automated decision with legal or similarly significant effects; safeguards include human intervention and contest. Đề hay đặt trong bối cảnh từ chối khoản vay.

front: Employees paste confidential data into public chatbots
back: Shadow AI: provide an approved enterprise tool, AUP, training, restrict unapproved tools. Cấm suông thường thất bại.

front: Customer responsibility on Amazon Bedrock
back: Access control, data classification, guardrail configuration, output evaluation, application compliance. AWS lo security of the cloud.

front: Does Amazon Bedrock train on your prompts?
back: No: Bedrock does not store or log prompts and completions, use them to train AWS models, or share them with third parties. Model provider không truy cập được deployment account.

ref.label: AWS blog: sensitive data in RAG

front: NIST AI RMF core functions
back: Govern (cross-cutting), Map, Measure, Manage. Framework tự nguyện, không certify.

front: Certifiable AI management system
back: ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), certified by an accredited third party. AWS đạt cho Amazon Bedrock từ 11/2024.

front: Bias drift
back: Bias that grows in production when live data shifts away from training data; needs ongoing fairness monitoring. Test một lần lúc launch là chưa đủ.

front: Hallucinated citations in a RAG assistant
back: Contextual grounding check, citations to approved sources, human review for high-stakes output. Guardrails chặn câu trả lời không bám nguồn.

front: EU AI Act obligations still applying from 2 August 2026
back: Article 50 transparency, such as chatbot disclosure, and most remaining provisions. Omnibus chỉ dời high-risk, không dời transparency.

front: Scope of AWS generative AI IP indemnity
back: Service Terms 50.10: GA features of listed services such as Amazon Nova, Amazon Q, Amazon Quick; excludes infringing inputs, disabled filters, fine-tuning causes. Model bên thứ ba trên Bedrock không thuộc danh sách.

front: Three lines of defense for AI
back: Line 1 business owns the risk; line 2 risk and compliance review independently; line 3 internal audit. AWS khuyên gắn AI vào enterprise risk management có sẵn.

ref.label: AWS blog: AI enterprise risk management

front: Vendor releases a new model version
back: Re-run evaluation against release criteria and update the system registry before switching (RAIER01-BP03). Benchmark công khai không thay đánh giá trên use case.
